answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake bonded per identity and slashed on proof of duplicate control: before paying a new agent, the ledger asks it to post collateral that is forfeited if one operator is later shown to run several personas. To claim a cedar identity you must lock funds, and a voyage through the reputation graph must reveal a distinct, costly path; a copied prism of a real account buys nothing. Faking a thousand agents thus costs a thousand forfeitable bonds.
